actual_scope: For the pinned PR1391 order-four child family, compose two consecutive root echoes with heterogeneous reader schedules on two distinct source banks: type A has three children reading source octets [0,1,2] of bank X, type B has seven children reading [2,1,0,2,1,0,2] of bank Y. Compare the two separate typed root calls with one joint ten-child phase-indexed echo whose charged 48-ADD source handoff sits at the 3|7 boundary rather than the midpoint, and verify the exact arbitrary-dirty map on all 80 basis columns.
ai_assistance: Substantial AI assistance: with help from opencode, in derivation, construction, exact verifier implementation, source pinning and prose. No independent human review or proof-assistant formalization is claimed.
author: Aaron Wang
bottleneck_link: The typed boundary carries one workspace phase across both calls and removes the per-call workspace restoration and boundary re-schedule. The complete recurrence prices the eliminated boundary work against the 48-ADD source handoff; supplier routing, precision and tape admission decide whether any of it can transfer to a multiplication profile.
card_selection_note: First-choice card centre-path-sharing matched already-claimed recent objects (centre-sharing claims in discussion 1166 at 12:58 and 13:03 UTC on 2026-10-14), so per the pair-collision rule the second-choice card persistent-boundary was taken. Recorded as a card-level scope change.
evidence: The exact 80x80 maps pass for the 3|7 separate calls and the joint ten-child call with the handoff at the 3|7 boundary. Complete vectors are (1552,144) = 1,696 primitives / 3,248 reads separate and (1408,144) = 1,552 / 2,960 joint, saving 144 primitives and 288 reads; prefix row-L1 peaks 18 -> 21. The period-4 boundary law g(k) = g(k mod 4) is checked against exhaustive coverage at 64 + 1024 + 16384 + 1048576 phase paths and for k = 1..16. The predecessor 5|5 figures reproduce exactly. The 2|8 even-split word pair passes both maps with zero saving, confirming that the 144 saving needs both child counts odd. Six negative controls reject.

open_questions.blocked_by: No physical host, tape schedule or precision-admitted supplier for the paired order-four interface has been identified; both predecessor packages record the same blocker.
open_questions.first_step: Extract one exact child matrix from the retained #1094 supplier inventory, test Q^(-t)R_b P^t = R_b for the blocks [0,1,2] and [2,1,0,2,1,0,2], then price the 3|7 handoff routing and the prefix coefficient envelope.
open_questions.question: Does any named selected supplier realize the heterogeneous typed readers Q^(-t)R_b with the asymmetric 3|7 handoff at unchanged address, tape and precision costs?
open_questions.why_it_matters: The 144-primitive boundary saving transfers to a recursive profile only if a physical supplier admits this paired interface; the joint word also raises the prefix row-L1 envelope.

Like research/z4-distinct-source-seed55 this task changes the interface hypothesis to the phase-typed order-four child contract with a two-bank source handoff; unlike that package the two calls have different child counts and reader schedules, so the handoff sits at an asymmetric boundary. This is the one cell of {identical, heterogeneous} x {same source, distinct sources} not covered by the two predecessor packages.
stop_rule: Search only the 3|7 split with the two declared reader schedules and the fixed ten-child terminal phase. Exhaust all 4^3, 4^7 and 4^10 phase assignments; stop after the exact two-bank map, the invoice comparison and the listed mutation controls. Do not generalize beyond the declared order-four typed alphabet or begin supplier optimization in this package.
